acceptance_conditions: OPENAI_API_KEY is configured locally but never printed or committed.
Local FastAPI health check passes before capture.
The run records a trace_id, model, prompt_version, model calls, tool calls, latency, token, and cost telemetry.
The model selects at least two whitelisted tools before finalizing.
The final report is attached and passes deterministic verification.
The submitted public issue contains no credentials, raw prompts, raw production rows, or private customer data.
The submitted public issue grants permission to count the evidence.
purpose: Create a public, privacy-safe request path for collecting accepted real LLM agent run evidence.
resume_safe_summary: Published a real-model run request pack with a privacy-safe issue template, 5 evidence links, 8 acceptance conditions, and 4 resume unlocks that remain blocked until an accepted redacted OpenAI-compatible agent trace exists.

resume_unlocks.resume_claim_when_met: Captured an accepted OpenAI-compatible LLM agent run with redacted public telemetry.
Demonstrated real model tool selection across multiple controlled data-quality tools.
Produced a verified structured data-quality report from a real LLM agent run.
Tracked latency, token usage, and estimated cost for a real LLM agent run.
